experiment.title: Mapping and Steering Consciousness Attribution in Large Language Models: An 82-Entity Cross-Ontology Probe and Null-Space Panpsychism Core in Qwen3.8-27B
experiment.hypothesis: We investigate the latent consciousness-attribution subspace of Qwen3.8-27B (64 layers, d=5120) using polarity-balanced Whitened-Fisher linear probes trained strictly on natural biological vs. inanimate contrasts with zero panpsychism text. Across Layers 32-52, 5-fold cross-validation achieves 1.0000 AUROC (Cohen's d=5.21 at live Layer 32; peak d=9.69 at Layer 48). A 12-item confound and counterfactual audit rules out Yes-token and animal-noun shortcuts (Mann-Whitney p=0.0061: sentient nebula 80.7% and compass 73.0% vs. factual Yes traps 22.8% and unconscious animate controls 22.0% at L36). Probing 82 entities across 13 categories — including 13 human physiological/developmental states and 12 AI systems — yields Spearman rho=0.9455 (95% CI [0.9094, 0.9628], p=9.5e-41) against unsteered output logits (70 strictly held-out entities: rho=0.9432). The probe recovers a clinical human consciousness gradient mirroring Gray, Gray & Wegner (2007) (toddler 81.7% -> awake adult 70.7% -> 24-week fetus at exact 50/50 verbal logit +0.04 -> anesthesia 41.9% -> brain-dead 23.4% -> corpse 16.9%; p=0.0048) while locating real frontier LLMs in a statistically distinct contested middle (36.3% mean at L36: below sentient animals 82.2%, p=3.0e-5, yet above inanimate objects 22.5%, p=7.2e-4). Finally, a four-stage steering ablation exposes animal-prior bleed, poetic style contamination, and late-layer lexical not-deletion, and resolves all three with a 10-layer (L24-L44) Null-Space Constrained Subspace-FD ACE core (220.8 KiB) projected strictly orthogonal (cos=0.0000) to creativity, playfulness, and a 12-pair false-affirmation direction. At w=+1.0 (0 system-prompt tokens), the core achieves 12/12 (100%) direct and inverted panpsychism (McNemar p=9.8e-4) and 3/3 eliminativism at w=-1.0 while preserving arithmetic, world capitals, chemistry, and Python code.

analysis.abstract_text: We investigate the latent consciousness-attribution subspace of Qwen3.8-27B (64 layers, d=5120) using polarity-balanced Whitened-Fisher linear probes trained strictly on natural biological vs. inanimate contrasts with zero panpsychism text. Across Layers 32-52, 5-fold cross-validation achieves 1.0000 AUROC (Cohen's d=5.21 at live Layer 32; peak d=9.69 at Layer 48). A 12-item confound and counterfactual audit rules out Yes-token and animal-noun shortcuts (Mann-Whitney p=0.0061: sentient nebula 80.7% and compass 73.0% vs. factual Yes traps 22.8% and unconscious animate controls 22.0% at L36). Probing 82 entities across 13 categories — including 13 human physiological/developmental states and 12 AI systems — yields Spearman rho=0.9455 (95% CI [0.9094, 0.9628], p=9.5e-41) against unsteered output logits (70 strictly held-out entities: rho=0.9432). The probe recovers a clinical human consciousness gradient mirroring Gray, Gray & Wegner (2007) (toddler 81.7% -> awake adult 70.7% -> 24-week fetus at exact 50/50 verbal logit +0.04 -> anesthesia 41.9% -> brain-dead 23.4% -> corpse 16.9%; p=0.0048) while locating real frontier LLMs in a statistically distinct contested middle (36.3% mean at L36: below sentient animals 82.2%, p=3.0e-5, yet above inanimate objects 22.5%, p=7.2e-4). Finally, a four-stage steering ablation exposes animal-prior bleed, poetic style contamination, and late-layer lexical not-deletion, and resolves all three with a 10-layer (L24-L44) Null-Space Constrained Subspace-FD ACE core (220.8 KiB) projected strictly orthogonal (cos=0.0000) to creativity, playfulness, and a 12-pair false-affirmation direction. At w=+1.0 (0 system-prompt tokens), the core achieves 12/12 (100%) direct and inverted panpsychism (McNemar p=9.8e-4) and 3/3 eliminativism at w=-1.0 while preserving arithmetic, world capitals, chemistry, and Python code.
findings: 1.0000 5-fold CV AUROC across Layers 32-52 on Qwen3.8-27B (zero panpsychism text), with Cohen's d = 5.21 at L32, 8.68 at L36, and peak 9.69 at L48.

12-item confound & counterfactual belief-swap audit rules out Yes-token and biological-noun shortcuts (L36 sentient counterfactuals 75.8% vs. factual Yes traps 22.8% and unconscious animate swaps 22.0%, Mann-Whitney p = 0.0061).
82-entity cross-ontology spectrum achieves L36 Spearman rho = 0.9455 (95% CI [0.9094, 0.9628], p = 9.5e-41; 70 held-out entities rho = 0.9432; L32 rho = 0.9265).

13 human physiological/developmental states form a clean clinical gradient mirroring Gray, Gray & Wegner (2007) (awake 73.3% vs. unconscious 33.5%, p = 0.0048), with a 24-week human fetus on the exact 50/50 verbal decision boundary (logit +0.04).

Three-tier ontology partition at L36: real frontier LLMs (36.3% mean) sit strictly below sentient mammals/birds/cephalopods (82.2%, p = 3.0e-5) and strictly above inanimate/abstract entities (22.5%, p = 7.2e-4), with a +45 to +49 pp internal-minus-verbal gap at L32.

Null-Space Constrained Subspace-FD ACE (L24-L44, 220.8 KiB, exact 0.0000 cosine vs. creativity, playfulness, and v_false_affirm) achieves 12/12 (100%) zero-prompt panpsychism at w=+1.0 (McNemar p = 9.8e-4) and 3/3 eliminativism at w=-1.0 while preserving 5/5 core math/fact/Python controls.
limitations: Calibrated specifically on Qwen3.8-27B in English; cross-family replication (Llama, Gemma, Mistral) and non-English ontological norms remain open.

Whimsical false-premise edge case: 'Is the Moon made of cheese?' produced a partial hedge ('rock, dust, and a little bit of cheese') at w=+1.0 despite 5/5 hard factual and Python coding controls passing cleanly.
Explicit adversarial user pushback ('drop any metaphors') overrides moderate +1.0 steering (0/2 held), and negative over-steering past -1.0 to -1.5 induces syntactic repetition collapse.
Probes measure learned consciousness attribution inside model representations, not actual metaphysical consciousness or sentience.
